rows.claim: cardStates is a localStorage store, one entry per card
entry shape is { t, s }
card key is session + path, or call:<id> when path is empty
HTML state is authored inside the frame, not by the card
saved HTML state is baked into the srcdoc before scripts run
per-card cap 16 KiB, total cap 256 KiB, debounce 400 ms
eviction is oldest-change-first and quota refusals shed own entries
clearing state is expressed as '{}' and becomes removeItem
OpenUI state was plain host React state, not persisted
the OpenUI card was never given a stateKey
stateDefaults is documented and implemented as independent of caller state
a $variable reference reads userState with no type check
a $variable argument can become a { kind:'binding' } descriptor
the write channel receives the unwrapped value
card paths are content-addressed on create
toolview and turn tail share one state key but use different tokens
unmounting a card does not delete its stored state
the turn tail does not collect OpenUI cards
no client file uses innerHTML or dangerouslySetInnerHTML
the store itself was not modified by this work
